summary: Frontend-only verification of the new TOTAL FLATS spec-grid feature across all 19 project detail pages on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 19 slugs render the TOTAL FLATS cell with the exact owner-confirmed values, positioned between FLOORS and YEAR, inside the project-stats-grid using md:grid-cols-6 on desktop and grid-cols-2 on mobile. Testid convention is 'project-stat-total flats' (label lowercased with space, as expected). Regression checks on nest (day/night toggle, floor plan viewer button, VISIT PROJECT SITE) and Ivy (G+4 floor still shown, glance grid intact) all pass. No page errors captured, no horizontal overflow on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Stats-grid data-testid uses label lowercased with a literal space ('project-stat-total flats'). Works but is fragile; consider slugifying labels (kebab-case) for a cleaner testid convention.
Line 44 uses truthiness check on project.totalFlats which would drop the cell if a project ever has 0 flats. Not an issue for current data but worth noting for future edge cases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The TOTAL FLATS feature is fully verified per owner-confirmed values across all 19 project detail pages on desktop and mobile. Testid convention for stats cells is 'project-stat-<label lowercased>' with spaces preserved, e.g. 'project-stat-total flats'. Grid uses md:grid-cols-6 when stats.length===6.
